si_4_title.answer: Multimodal normative modeling in Alzheimer's Disease with introspective variational autoencoders

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Using multimodal neuroimaging biomarkers from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) dataset, our proposed multimodal introspective VAE demonstrated superior reconstruction of healthy controls

answer.ADNI: normative training (N=248), separate holdout cohort for evaluation (N=48), and disease cohort for outlier detection and clinical research (N=726)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: For training, we selected 248 cognitively unimpaired (healthy control) subjects from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging (ADNI) dataset ... For model evaluation, we used 48 healthy controls for a separate holdout cohort and a disease cohort of 726 amyloid positive AD spectrum (ADS) individuals
